text: Are you awake, responding normally, and free of severe chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding right now?
Yes, I am awake and responding. I have no chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding.
Can you tell me what happened, when it started, and how bad the pain is on a scale from 0 to 10?
I've had constant lower abdominal pain since this morning that's getting worse. It hurts about an 8 out of 10 right now.
Could you please tell me if you take any regular medications?
No, I only take pregnancy vitamins. That is all my medication.

sources: ESI v5 p.14 (Abdominal and Gastrointestinal Concerns, assessment questions)

text: Do you have any allergies to medicines, or any other medical conditions such as heart problems, diabetes, pregnancy, or issues affecting your immune system?
No allergies. My only condition is being 28 weeks pregnant.
Just to confirm for our medical records, are you currently considered immunocompromised?
No, I have no other conditions besides my pregnancy and no allergies. I don't know if that makes me immunocompromised.
Do you have any fever, rash, recent overseas travel within the last two weeks, or contact with anyone who is currently infectious?
No fever or rash. No travel or contact with anyone infectious.
Could you please tell us when you last ate or drank, and provide your name and date of birth for the hospital's records?
I had dinner last night; my name is not provided but my date of birth is September 3, 1986.
